cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes outside, same as you. Lovely to have you staying, but shoes must remain on the step.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are muddy. Yours are dry; you can bring them in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, keep the mud outside. I'll lend you slippers, but those stay indoors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll clean my shoes before my train. Could I use your sink?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happily—I'll bring a bowl outside. Leave the slippers here, please; they stay indoors.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies shoes outside as an absolute host rule; B2 reveals mud, not ritual. A3 covers and warmly adds indoor-only slippers, enforced in A5.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 mud causes A3 slippers; B4 washing request causes A5 outdoor bowl while preserving the slipper limit.

relationship.evidence: B2 helps A distinguish clean shoes, and B4 offers to clean its own shoes before travel.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 solution to impose another boundary on how the offered help happens.

specificity.evidence: A1 staying establishes host and guest; B4 train gives practical time pressure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 happily and the outdoor bowl offer preserve kindness while the slipper instruction has a clear purpose.
